name: First Due
description: Ingests active CAD dispatches or AVL device locations from the First Due REST API - active dispatches are written to CloudTAK Events with their dispatched units as Assignments, AVL device locations are posted to the map.

permissions.description: First Due posts AVL device locations to the map when DataType is AVL
First Due creates an Event for every active dispatch
First Due looks up the Event previously created for a dispatch when its cache has no record of it
First Due updates Events as dispatches change and ends them when the call closes
First Due assigns the units dispatched to a call to its Event
First Due reads the Assignments of an Event to reconcile them with the units currently dispatched
First Due updates the Assignments of the units dispatched to a call
First Due removes units that are no longer dispatched to a call
First Due geocodes dispatch addresses that have no coordinates via the CloudTAK search API

schedule.description: Polls the First Due active dispatch or device location API on a schedule - defaults to every 15 seconds.
